items.claim: Difference lens's captures kept in the shot map for the workshop's life
Replaced, cleared, or detached Pixels shot's ImageBitmap never closed
items.note: `docs/unruled.md` already lists this as an open question ("whether a `LensCapture`'s bitmap stays valid after the source's next capture"). `capture()` hands the shot out to callers such as the Contrast readout and the Grid, which may still paint it later.

items.claim: Contrast readout over Pixels posts a capture on every reticle move
items.note: It now waits through labkit's `useCaptureDelay`, which is newly exported from `@weasel-js/labkit/loupe` with a `minor` `api` changeset.

items.claim: Split lens's readouts find nothing once the seam is right of center
items.note: labkit's `Lens.less` now lifts the compared side's clip during the interior probe. The new test is in `readouts.browser.test.tsx` and is unrun here.

items.claim: Live copy keeps its host's old size after a resize under a still reticle
items.note: which compares the host size in the request. Also 3b44b1a2c7: a pane resize fires no window `resize`, so Live and Pixels lenses now watch their host with a `ResizeObserver`.

items.claim: Contrast readout's Pixels reading stays on the old DPR
Compare menu gives two rows the same variant key
items.note: Rows are keyed by option index. labkit config options are strings only, so the object-value case can't happen; the dotted-path collision could.

items.claim: `tokenChain` drops declarations written after a nested rule
Replaced or dropped Pixels shot's ImageBitmap never closed
items.note: duplicate of A's bitmap finding above

items.claim: Pixels Contrast readout posts a capture on every move
Live and Pixels lenses never re-resolve when the OS color scheme flips
Token chain cache ignores attribute and inline-style changes on the element or ancestors
